en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a narrow street lined with old townhouses. The central focus is a tall, steep‑roofed building with a prominent wooden façade and balcony, flanked by more classical masonry houses with wrought‑iron balconies. A woman stands in a doorway at street level. Printed text in French appears at the bottom margin, identifying the scene as a wooden façade in Bruges and naming the publisher.
